<translate>
<!--T:3-->
The '''Saiyan Saga''' is the second saga of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas|story mode]]. It opens once you complete every quest of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] and covers Raditz, training with Piccolo and at [[Special:MyLanguage/Kami's Lookout|Kami's Lookout]], the Saibamen, Nappa and Vegeta. The saga ends by repairing Vegeta's pod and flying to [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]]: ''Prepare for Namek'' rewards a [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Saiyan Space Pod]].
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:4-->
Completing its first quest, ''Defeat Raditz'', also opens the [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]], which runs alongside the main story. Completing every quest opens the [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Saga|Frieza Saga]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Notes == <!--T:71-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:72-->
* Quest 15, ''Prepare for Namek'', opens 5 real-time minutes after it becomes available.
* Quest 13 asks for 12 [[Special:MyLanguage/Golden Carrot|Golden Carrots]], and quest 14 for the iron, redstone and diamonds Bulma needs to repair Vegeta's pod.
* Several quests send you to [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|masters]]: [[Special:MyLanguage/Piccolo|Piccolo]] (quest 2), [[Special:MyLanguage/Korin|Korin]] (quest 10) and [[Special:MyLanguage/Krillin|Krillin]] (quest 13).
* Most of the early Movies Saga quests (Garlic Jr., Dr. Wheelo, [[Special:MyLanguage/Turles|Turles]] and Lord Slug) open after quests 11 and 12 of this saga.
</translate>
